providers.reason: Led semis rebound with 3%+ gain; benefits directly from Dell and broader AI server demand acceleration confirmed in recent results.

providers.reason: Momentum is strong: Dell's record AI-server quarter validated demand and lifted NVDA 3%+, while a ~$14B Hugging Face acquisition could be announced as soon as this week, adding an AI-ecosystem catalyst. The Sept 10 dividend record date also focuses investor attention.
providers.risk: The Hugging Face deal may not close on the reported timeline or could face regulatory scrutiny, triggering profit-taking after the recent run.
